about: The DataTable files in this folder, the C++ row struct each fills, and every member with its type. The structs are declared in unreal/Source/Tervain/Public/Data/TervainRows.h, written by the same export.

tables.note: An item. The row name is the item’s id.

NameKey.note: String table key of its name.

DescriptionKey.note: String table key of its description.

HealAmount.note: Health restored when consumed; 0 for anything else.

tables.note: How a kind of animal meets the hunter and how far it calls. The row name is the species.

NoticeDistance.note: It looks up at the hunter within this distance (cm).

FleeDistance.note: It flees, or a predator stands its ground, within this distance (cm).

HoldUntil.note: A predator holds its ground until the hunter is within this share of the flee distance; 1 for prey.

HerdAlarmDistance.note: An alarm carries to its own kind within this distance (cm); 0 for solitary kinds.

CallReach.note: It calls only when someone is within this distance, and its call is heard out to it (cm).

tables.note: One animal and its home. The row name is its species and model id.

SourceModel.note: The web build’s model file, for reference while it is replaced.

Home.note: The centre of its range, on the ground (cm).

RoamRadius.note: How far from home it wanders (cm).

WalkSpeed.note: Walking pace (cm/s); the stride is played to match. 0 for an animal that never walks.

RunSpeed.note: Running pace (cm/s); the stride is played to match. 0 for an animal that never walks.

bSeated.note: It sits in one place and never walks.

bTame.note: It watches travellers and does not flee; the tame deer can be ridden.

HomeYaw.note: Its facing at home (degrees), when bHasHomeYaw.

bHasHomeYaw.note: Whether HomeYaw is set; otherwise it faces at random.

tables.note: A kind of hostile. The row name is the archetype.

Reach.note: Distance at which it starts its attack (cm).

WindUpSeconds.note: Seconds of wind-up before the strike.

Damage.note: Damage of a blow that lands unguarded.

NoticeDistance.note: Distance within which it can notice the wanderer (cm).

bHeavy.note: A heavy blow: it lunges, costs more to block and can break a guard.

tables.note: Where a hostile waits. The row name is the encounter’s id, as saved games know it.

Location.note: Where it stands, on the ground (cm).

Leash.note: How far from its post it will chase (cm).

tables.note: A named place the journal and map know. The row name is the place’s id.

Location.note: Where it stands, on the ground (cm).

Radius.note: The wanderer has found it once within this distance (cm).

tables.note: A building’s footprint. The row name is the building’s id.

Location.note: The centre of its footprint, on the ground (cm).

Yaw.note: The way its front door faces (degrees).

tables.note: A named resident. The row name is their role id, which survives changes of display name.

TitleKey.note: String table key of their title.

HomeAnchor.note: The anchor they rest at when no span covers the hour.

InteractRadius.note: How near the wanderer must be to speak to them (cm).

Schedule.note: Their day, in order; the first span that covers the hour applies.

tables.note: A barrel or crate that can be pushed, lifted and thrown. The row name is its id, as saved games know it.

DisplayName.note: Shown when it can be picked up.

Location.note: Where it stands, on the ground (cm).

tables.note: One tree or shrub of the forest as the web build plants it. Row names are stable only for one export.

Species.note: oak, birch, pine, fir, shorepine, dead, orchard, shrub or palm.

Variant.note: Which of the species’ models, 0 to 2.

Location.note: Where it stands, on the ground (cm).

TrunkRadius.note: Radius of the trunk as an obstacle to movement (cm); 0 for a tree or shrub that does not block.

NavigationRadius.note: Radius the walk grid keeps clear of (cm): the trunk or the drawn wood, whichever reaches further; 0 if it does not block.

structs.name: FTervainScheduleEntry
structs.note: One span of a resident’s day. A span may run past midnight (FromHour greater than ToHour).

FromHour.note: Hour of the day the span starts, 0 to 24.

ToHour.note: Hour of the day the span ends.

Anchor.note: The named place they go to (data/world/layout.json, anchors).

IndoorPost.note: A furnished spot inside the anchor’s building, or none.

ETervainItemAction.note: What using an item from the hotbar does.

ETervainAnimalHabitat.note: The ground an animal keeps to.

ETervainBuildingKind.note: What a building is used for.

ETervainActivity.note: What a resident does at a place.
